questions.prompt: What does http.get<Order>('/api/orders/1') guarantee at runtime?

options.text: That the response body matches the Order interface
Nothing about the shape: the generic only tells the compiler what you expect
That the response is an instance of the Order class
That missing fields are filled with defaults

questions.explanation: Types are erased at runtime. The generic is a promise to the compiler, not a check. Validate data at the boundary if you need guarantees.

questions.prompt: Match each kind of code to the TypeScript construct it should usually use.
questions.explanation: Interfaces describe plain data, type aliases express unions and derived types, and classes hold behavior that Angular instantiates and injects.

questions.prompt: Which type accepts any value but forces you to narrow it before you can use it?
questions.explanation: unknown is the safe replacement for any at trust boundaries such as JSON.parse results, caught errors, and postMessage data.

questions.prompt: Which of these narrow a value to a more specific type? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: typeof, instanceof, and in are real runtime checks that TypeScript understands. A cast with 'as' checks nothing; it only silences the compiler.

questions.prompt: Why add a default branch that calls assertNever(question) in a switch over a discriminated union?

options.text: It makes the switch run faster
It logs unknown values in production
The compiler errors as soon as a new union member is added but not handled
It converts the union into an enum

questions.explanation: If every case is handled, the value is 'never' in the default branch. A new, unhandled member makes it not-never, so passing it to assertNever fails to compile.

questions.prompt: Given interface ExerciseSet { id: string; exercise: string; reps: number }, which type best describes an entry that hasn't been saved yet (the server assigns the id)?
questions.explanation: Omit removes the id but keeps every other field required. Partial would make every field optional, which is too loose for a create payload.
